text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We're in my office, and Ines Fujin has
been
talking to someone on the phone
for a while now.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Right. Yes... but Mom, it's what Cassie
and Polly
want...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, just leave it to me... Don't worry,
I'll be
fine! Talk to you soon!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Now then, Trainer! I need a big favor!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's almost time for Ines Fujin's race to
begin. In
the waiting room, a pair of
Umamusume twins are
perched happily
on chairs.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Now listen up, you two! Make sure you
do what
my trainer tells you to while I'm
not here!

text_block_list.name: Ines's Little Sisters
text_block_list.text: We will!

text_block_list.name: Ines's Little Sisters
text_block_list.text: Yaaay!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin's little sisters have come to
watch her
debut race. That big favor she
wanted was for me
to look after them.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Thanks for bringing them both here.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, my race overlaps with our
mom's
hospital visit, but they both kept
pleading for the
chance to come along
and watch me.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Haha, okay. I'm counting on you!
choice_data_list: 大丈夫、君はレースに集中して
大丈夫、貴方はレースに集中して
choice_data_list_en: Don't worry, just focus on the race.
Don't worry, you just focus on the race.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna head to the paddock. Wish me
luck!

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text:
W-wait a sec! The two of us have
something we
want to show you, sis!

Ready, set...

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text: Spin, spin, and pom-poms!

text_block_list.name: Little Sister B
text_block_list.text: Pom-pom! One, two...

text_block_list.name: Ines's Little Sisters
text_block_list.text:
"Do your best, Big Sis!"
Hehe, did you
like our cheer dance?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Haha! That was fantastic! Thanks a
bunch, you
two!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You've given your big sis a huge energy
boost! I'm
gonna have to reward you by
finishing in first
place!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After saying goodbye to Ines Fujin, I
take the
twins by their hands and lead
them over to the
spectator seating.

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text:
Wow! So this is Nakayama Racecourse...
It looks
different on TV, huh?

text_block_list.name: Little Sister B
text_block_list.text: There's not that many people, either.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I imagine they're more accustomed to
seeing the
Nakayama Racecourse filled
to the rafters during
the Arima Kinen
and Satsuki Sho.
choice_data_list: これからあるのはデビュー戦だから
choice_data_list_en: Because what's coming up is your debut race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The only people in the stands right now
are the
race organizers and avid fans. It
probably feels
different from that big,
festival-like vibe.

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text: Huh, I see.

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text:
No, this is still really great! We get to
watch Big
Sis race!
choice_data_list: 楽しみにしてたものと違った？
choice_data_list_en: Was it different from what you were looking forward to?

text_block_list.name: Little Sister B
text_block_list.text:
She loves running a whole bunch! And I
love
seeing her have fun!

text_block_list.name: Ines's Little Sisters
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Ines's Little Sisters
text_block_list.text:
Right! So we're gonna cheer extra loud
to help her
win!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Inhale... Exhale...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Gotta calm these nerves... I can do this! I
just have to
remember what my trainer
taught me!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
It figures there aren't many spectators at
my first
race. I just need to produce
results—then my
popularity will soar!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (I can hear so many different voices.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(Voices from the Umamusume I'm
competing
against, and those from the
spectators waiting
just beyond the
paddock.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Inhale... exhale...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(Is that an announcement? They must be
using a
high quality speaker system. I
can hear the sounds
of the paddock
from here.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(I wonder if my number has already
appeared on
the jumbotron.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Inhale...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: This is it—the real deal.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Ladies and gentlemen, please join us as
we watch
these courageous Umamusume
take the first steps
on their racing
journeys!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Twinkle Series, here I come!
